subject: SIG: Clarification on Hosted / Dedicated / Private scope and evidence mapping
messages:
From: Alice Morgan <security@acme-corp.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Li <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG — Clarification: which deployment modes require which evidence?

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for taking SIG questions. We’re reviewing your completed questionnaire and want to make sure we map the supporting artifacts correctly for our audit team. Two quick requests: 

1) Can you confirm which SIG sections and attachments are applicable to each deployment mode (Hosted API, Redwood Dedicated, Redwood Private/VPC or on-prem package)? For example, does the Dedicated offering get the same network diagrams and KMS evidence as Private?

2) For Dedicated, we need to understand the tenant/network isolation boundaries and any customer-isolated encryption (KMS/HSM) options — ideally a diagram and a short blurb we can include in our vendor report.

If you can provide a short mapping and attach any diagrams or a package we can ingest, that would be most helpful. Our timeline: internal review by Nov 24.

Appreciate it —
Alice Morgan
Head of Security Operations
Acme Corp

Attachments: none
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <security@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Bob Li <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 13:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG — Clarification: which deployment modes require which evidence?

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the clear ask. Quick summary up front (full detail and attachments below):

- Hosted API: Redwood controls the infrastructure; we provide SOC 2 report, standard network diagram (shared infra), and logical controls. No customer-managed KMS by default — we offer per-tenant logical separation and customer data isolation at the application layer.

- Redwood Dedicated: Single-tenant GPU pools reserved for the customer. You get additional isolation docs: dedicated network boundary diagram, tenant VLAN mapping, and optional customer KMS integration (Bring Your Own Key) for model artifacts and logs.

- Redwood Private (VPC / on-prem): Full customer-controlled network. We provide deployment runbooks, audit-log configuration examples, and instructions to integrate your KMS/HSM. On-prem package includes an install checklist and evidence hooks for your internal auditors.

I attached a short index (hosting_evidence_index.csv) that maps SIG sections to artifacts per deployment mode. I’m looping in Marissa for SLA and contract-level evidence (eg, Dedicated SLAs, uptime SLOs) and Karthik for the VPC/on-prem technical artifacts.

Next steps I propose:
- Karthik to drop the network diagram and packet of technical artifacts by EOD tomorrow.
- Marissa to confirm any contract-level wording we need to include for the procurement packet.

Let me know if you want a single ZIP package or separate docs per section.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Security & Compliance (Sales Enablement)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: hosting_evidence_index.csv (text/csv)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Morgan <security@acme-corp.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Bob Li <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG — Clarification: which deployment modes require which evidence? — technical artifacts attached

Hi Alice / team,

Following up with the technical mapping and the requested diagram. Key points: 

- Network & isolation: see attached redwood_sg_network_diagram.pdf — it shows three columns for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. For Dedicated we show dedicated GPU pools on a customer-dedicated VLAN with a customer tenancy tag; control plane (orchestration) remains logically separated but we provide a private management plane connection option.

- Encryption / KMS: Hosted — server-side encryption with our managed keys (customer-level logical separation). Dedicated — we support BYOK for object storage and model artifact encryption; Private — you manage keys in your cloud KMS or on-prem HSM. We include KMS integration runbooks in the Private package.

- Evidence applicability: many SIG control responses are identical across modes (policies, SOC 2 attachments). The differences are primarily in: network segmentation artifacts, KMS key ownership evidence, and deployment runbooks. 

I attached a short evidence bundle for Dedicated (configuration extracts, VLAN mapping examples) in the planned zip. If you prefer, we can produce two bundles: one for Hosted/Dedicated (what Redwood can provide directly) and one separate Private/VPC package that contains install-time evidence you run internally.

Attachment stubs included below — let me know if you want the full package as a single zip.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_sg_network_diagram.pdf (application/pdf); dedicated_configuration_snippets.txt (text/plain)

This is helpful. Procurement would prefer one consolidated evidence bundle we can ingest into our vendor portal (catalog record). Can you produce:

Thanks —
